decisions.reason: As the publicly announced flagship of the firm's innovative direction, its high sunk costs and visible commitment make withdrawal very unlikely.
The foldable large container line has dedicated website presence and multiple models, indicating substantial investment and public commitment that support continued persistence.
Though the rackable pallet line has sunk development costs, its lower public visibility compared to other lines yields a moderate but still below-threshold drop probability.
With its own webpage and multiple models, the spill-retention pallet line carries high public visibility and investment, making escalation of commitment likely.
As a single product with its own page, it has public commitment but less invested than product lines, resulting in a moderately low drop probability.
